::: {.content-section}

The User Meetings bring together planetarium operators, museum staff, educators, researchers, and developers from across the OpenSpace community. Sessions cover new feature demos, dome integration techniques, use-case showcases, and hands-on training. It's where the project's direction gets shaped — by the people building with it.

:::
